caption_en:
Famine in Gaza. Watch. 🍞

The hunger was real. On 22 Aug 2025 the IPC (Integrated Food Security Phase Classification) confirmed famine in Gaza Governorate, around Gaza City. Israel rejected the finding and its method.

Then the ceasefire, 10 Oct 2025. COGAT (Coordination of Government Activities in the Territories, Israel's aid coordinator) says about 1.78 million tons of food entered from Oct 2025 to Jun 2026 (COGAT report, 9 Jul 2026). UN-tracked figures are lower, as they cover UN channels only.

Prices per kg, Gaza governorate, first week of Oct 2025 to last week of Mar 2026 (WFP Market Monitor, Mar 2026): flour 7.20 to 2.80 NIS (down 61%), sugar 12 to 5 (down 58%), tomatoes 55 to 19 (down 65%). Flour was still 47% above pre-war, and WFP noted commercial flour was absent from markets.

Famine level (IPC Phase 5): 104,000 people in Oct to Nov 2025 (IPC, 19 Dec 2025). Apr to Jun 2026: none (IPC, 23 Jul 2026). Hunger is not over: 1.2 million people (59%) faced crisis or worse, projected to reach 1.4 million (67%) by Dec 2026, and about 74,000 children are expected to need treatment for acute malnutrition.

Aid and HAMAS: on 31 Oct 2025 the U.S.-led Civil-Military Coordination Center (CMCC) said a U.S. drone observed suspected HAMAS operatives looting an aid truck (U.S. Central Command). On 13 Jul 2026 UN official Ramiz Alakbarov said armed personnel affiliated with Gaza's de facto authorities forcibly entered a food distribution point in Jabalia: "These incidents are not isolated." HAMAS denied it, saying its police were searching for smuggled goods (Reuters).

Where is hunger worst right now? People at famine level (IPC Phase 5) | share in crisis or worse (Phase 3+), latest 2026 analyses:
Sudan: about 135,000 | two in five (IPC via FAO, UNICEF, WFP, 15 May 2026)
South Sudan: 73,300 | 56% (IPC, Apr to Jul 2026)
Yemen: about 41,000 projected | over half (Global Report on Food Crises 2026)
Gaza: 0 | 59% (IPC, Jul 2026)
Haiti: no Phase 5 figure found | 52% (IPC, Mar to Jun 2026)
North Korea: no IPC analysis
Gaza's share in crisis is still among the highest here. The gap is at the famine level.

Photos: Eliran t (CC BY-SA 4.0, WFP sack, Gaza Strip, 2024); Ashraf Amra (CC BY-SA 3.0 IGO, Al-Mawasi, Jan 2025); U.S. Army, public domain (Kerem Shalom 13 Nov 2025, Zikim 25 Nov 2025, Kissufim 3 Dec 2025, CMCC 23 Nov 2025); via Wikimedia Commons. AI voice.

Gazans deserve food, and better than HAMAS. Send this to someone.
caption_he:
רעב בעזה. תראו.
הרעב היה אמיתי: באוגוסט 2025 ה־IPC (סיווג שלבי ביטחון תזונתי) הכריז על רעב באזור העיר עזה. ישראל חלקה על השיטה.
אחרי הפסקת האש: כ־1.78 מיליון טון מזון עד יוני 2026 (מתפ"ש). קמח, סוכר ועגבניות זולים בכ־60% (WFP, מרץ 2026).
ברמת רעב (שלב 5): 104,000 בסוף 2025. ביולי 2026: אפס. אבל 1.2 מיליון עדיין במשבר או גרוע מזה.
ובינתיים: חשד לביזת משאית סיוע בידי חמאס (פיקוד המרכז האמריקאי, אוקטובר 2025), והאו"ם מאשים אנשים מטעם שלטון חמאס בפריצה לנקודת חלוקת מזון (יולי 2026). חמאס מכחיש.
סודאן: 135,000 ברמת רעב. ולאן העולם מסתכל?
לתושבי עזה מגיע אוכל, ומגיע להם יותר מחמאס.

Israel disputed the method. But the hunger was real.
Then, in October: a ceasefire. And trucks.
By June, Israel counted one point seven eight million tons of food.
Flour, sugar, tomatoes? About sixty percent cheaper, says the UN's food agency.
Late twenty twenty-five: a hundred thousand Gazans at the famine level.
Hunger isn't over. One point two million still face crisis or worse.
And the food? A U.S. drone filmed suspected <<h|ɑ|ˈ|m|ɑ|s>> men looting an aid truck.
